ftbquests.chapter.escaping.quest54C2818E: In order to escape, all 12 eyes must be collected and placed in a portal frame.
These portal frames are extremely rare and only found in areas guarded by the strongest sculk mobs. Look for a room with 4 entrances and an ominous heartbeat echoing from within.
If you are ever confused, look back in the questbook on how to obtain the different eyes.
ftbquests.chapter.escaping.quest890E05CB: If you are having trouble finding one, perhaps one of the reality chips can help...
ftbquests.chapter.escaping.title: Escaping
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest24C4318: The Kekimurus can be found somewhere in the poolrooms.
This advanced flower can generate mana very quickly as long as you provide it with sufficient amounts of cake.
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest25DBA9E: All the water of the poolrooms seems to flow towards an exit.
You'll know when you find it.
Against your better judgement, it may be worth a try?
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest296793F: What sadist would fill a swimming pool full of molten silver?
Whatever the case, it must be found and exploited as soon as possible.
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest3E7CD93: The exceptionally high chlorine content of the poolrooms renders normal maps almost unreadable...
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest43F641A: Ornate golden tiles can be found in a few rooms. They can also be collected collected with a pickaxe, but don't chip them too much...
Alternatively, you can use an extruder to safely collect the tiles as they grow. They can then be melted down for gold!
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest4747407: Pool Tiles can be broken off using a pickaxe.
Much like the walls and carpet of the backrooms, they too seem to regenerate...
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest5F72147: Using Reality Alloy, you can make a chest that can transport items from one dimension to another.
This is exceptionally handy for transporting items to and from the poolrooms.
Now you are Thinking with Portals
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest6574AC1: You can collect Aluminium by placing the extruder on a block missing pool tiles.
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.quest6681943: The Exotic Eye can be found somewhere in the Poolrooms.
Its guardian protectors will not let it be stolen so easily...
ftbquests.chapter.poolrooms.title: Poolrooms
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest154EA3B6: It might be good to document this liminal place by snapping some pictures.
You can take pictures and develop them using the Lightroom.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest23E59069: You can cut open the carpet using a knife, revealing some strange concrete tiles underneath.
With a wooden pickaxe you can mine your newly discovered concrete tiles for small pieces of concrete.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest2FD58013: Wooden tools are essential to your success. With them, you can begin to harvest more resources from the strange rooms around you.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest3026FA82: You can make a furnace out of concrete pieces for all your smelting needs.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest307781E7: Clay can be made by washing Carpet Dust with a Encased Fan and a Sponge. See the previous quest for an example.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest43F1C034: It is very important that you automate as many tasks as possible. After chapter 2, automation is almost a must if you want to be able to progress efficiently.
Taking the time to automate a task by making dedicated machines is almost always worth it compared to doing everything by hand.
It is technically possible to do everything manually, but it is far from ideal.
Liminality shall make room for automation
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest45184889: If you don't feel like getting lost, then it is a good idea to make some chalk.
With Chalk you can draw arrows anywhere you want.
If you shift+right-click with a piece of chalk on a block, you can draw symbols that can help you remind yourself where to go and where to stay very far away from.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest4949E27E: By washing the wallpaper, you can obtain paper, which can be folded into thin cardboard for some basic armor.
It provides no defense, but its better than nothing.
On the bright side, at least it allows you to sprint for much longer than you would be able to in heavier armor.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest49C5EB9D: Some parts of these rooms seem to be infected with sculk. It's probably best to stay as far away from the stuff as possible.
Barricading corridors to infected rooms might also prove an effective tactic.
Turn away when you see sculk
Whats the worst that could happen?
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest4D215AD9: The seeds that you found in the carpet can be put to good use.
They will need to be planted on Soggy Carpet.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest4E7AB902: You can gain additional wood by placing wooden furniture on top of a cutting board and chopping it with an axe.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest6C636EA0: You can collect water by right-clicking Soggy Carpet with a sponge.
Soggy Carpet can be found all throughout the backrooms. It is slightly darker than normal carpet.
You can make carpet soggy by right-clicking wet sponges on dry carpet.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest74DC667B: If you have not yet adjusted to your new liminal environment. Then don't worry, let us make our own base and make it a bit more cozy.
The random furniture scattered across the backrooms could probably be repurposed into planks to increase your chance of survival.
Let's get started with making a crafting table. Start with crafting a chair into planks.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest77AB8365: You might have found out about the carpet inhabitants by now. The eggs they drop are a good source of protein.
Killing them with a knife will drop additional eggs.
They have an aquired taste, however...
If you need bowls, they can sometimes be found in coolers.
Crush with Blade, Releases Juice Better
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest7A0ECC43: If you are lost on how to construct an Alloy Kiln, then please refer to the Engineers Manual.
There is Always a Bigger Furnace
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest7A8C6804: A Mechanical Fan can be created by right-clicking a barrel with a propeller.
You can use wet sponges as a source of washing. The fan will blow right through it.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest7FAC527C: You can use brushes to sweep up carpet dust.
&oNote: The effects of long term carpet dust exposure are unknown.
This Place could use some Sweeping
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.quest9DBA6DD7: You can scrape the wallpaper off the walls using any axe. This can provide the resources to make a small backpack.
We are going on an Adventure!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_1.title: Chapter 1
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest12F6EDB7: Somewhere within the infinite library sits a forgotten eye staring at endless books.
Search atop of the giant piles of books and other lost junk.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest1773F3D3: Time to bring some more life to this place
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest20CA5E31: Backpacks can be made using leather obtained from scrapping books.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest2138ADDD: You can turn Livingwood into Charcoal using the coke oven.
After that, Charcoal can be turned into Coal Coke.
Which means that every plank can, in theory, be turned into Coal Coke with the right setup.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest21C50BEE: You can cast a portal with ten buckets of lava and water.
The nether can be used as a shortcut to diffrent places in the backrooms. Do note that a portal must always be constructed from the Backrooms to the Nether.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest22FF2879: Ashes can be obtained by lighting anything that can catch fire. After the block burns up, it will make ash that can be picked up using a shovel.

What to burn is entirely up to you. Wood is not super easy to come by in large quantities and the carpet and wallpaper are somehow resistant to the flames. But perhaps you can find something made out of cardboard...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest2301997F: A lot of furniture can be turned into Blocks of Charcoal.
That should be a good source of fuel for the upcoming steam age.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest2A93ADA6: Sugarcane grows much faster on snad.
Snad not only allows for faster growth, updating it with redstone will force the plant on top of it to grow instantly.
Can this be exploited? You be the judge.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest2C7588D4: The Engineer's crafting table can craft items a bit faster than normal crafting tables, and can store crafting ingredients!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest2FEA5907: Using the petal apothocary, you can convert those seeds you found in the carpet into better ones!
Strawberries can be difficult to farm since they need a light source placed directly above them in order to grow. They, however, will instantly heal you slightly upon consumption.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest3220EA10: Treated wood is required for many advanced workstations.
Simply take any regular planks and a bucket of creosete from the coke oven, and combine them in a crafting table! And yes, the ceramic bucket can be used too, even though it is not shown by jei.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest347FB9BA: If you are sick of eating nothing but berries (and possibly silverfish eggs), look no further!
Using a cooking pot, you can cook your berries into Liminal Jam.
But first you will need to obtain Sugar Cane from the Petal Apothecary.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest495E194A: Floral Fertiliser can be used on soggy carpet to bring some colour to this monochrome place.
Any dye can be used to make it in the Petal Apothecary. Yellow dye is the easiest to obtain since it can be extracted from wallpaper by washing it with an Encased Fan.
Bones can be obtained from enemies, or alternatively from a composter.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest4EFCB9F8: You can convert treated wood into Livingwood by placing it next to a pure daisy.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest594A42AE: It is time to construct your first steam engine!
All it needs is some fuel in the basic burners and a good supply of water.
Water can be pumped out of an infinite water source, as shown in the image below.
The steam engine will need to pump its own water; you just need to kickstart it with a Hand Crank.
You will need to use one or more basic burners to heat it. Campfires do not produce enough heat to power the engine, and for some odd reason, lava does not seem to either...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest5DBBF595: Treated wood crates keep their items inside when broken, allowing easy transportation of items.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest60885F74: If you need any redstone, cutting these spores can yield some.
Surely there is a way to grow more...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest60DCFFC6: Using the smeltery, metal appliances can be melted down and repurposed.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.quest63B87060: With Mystical Flowers you can make all the dyes.
This will allow you to start painting with other colours than just yellow.
You can add dyes to your palette by crafting the palette and dyes together on a crafting table.
It is now also possible to develop colour film in the Lightroom.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_2.title: Chapter 2
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest15158562: Using the Keg, you can farm up a lot of the special spores. These spores can be turned into very useful resources.
Fully automating the keg might be a really good idea since the process can be quite slow when having to move the spores manually over and over again.
Of course it also allows you to get completely drunk on alcoholic beverages.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest1CBBDFF2: This tool should be able to pry open those drains you may have found in some of the rooms.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest1FF2EB0F: Using the package system from Create is optional. It can be a very convenient way of managing your items.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest21DFDC21: In order for the Sculk Scrubber to function, it must be placed above a block of Sculk.
When you have done this correctly, it can be right-clicked in order to activate the machine.
Upon activation it will start absorbing the sculk, leaving a strange but safe porous stone behind. It will also deal massive damage to sculk mobs.
It should be noted that nothing can be placed directly on the sculk, not even the sculk scrubber. In order to get it in the right position, you need to place it on the side of a non-sculk block.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest2294336C: This place could use some Automated Sweeping
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest23C3453D: Using this net, you can automatically catch items lost in the water.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest240D7B64: You can also restore the damage you have brought to the backrooms by:
- Right-clicking broken ceiling lamps with fluorescent tubes
- Right-clicking Timber Frames with wallpaper will create Fake Wallpaper

If you like the aesthetic of the concrete tiles you can also turn the concrete tiles into full blocks by right-clicking them with a piece of concrete. This will also prevent the tiles from growing their carpet back.
All of this may sound like an insane idea, but turning the lights back on might not be so bad.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest2553A619: Using the endoflame, mana spreader and mana pool you can generate mana.
If you are confused on how this works then consult the Lexa Botania for more information on mana generation.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest26012980: With the smeltery and a tinker's anvil, you can now forge customized weapons with special effects.
Click on a drain block to add buckets of molten metal to your smeltery.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest296A0E86: The Advanced Blast Furnace is a lot faster. It can use powered preheaters to make the steel-making process even faster.
Additionally, it supports automatic inputs and outputs. Just make sure you have a chest placed in front of its output, and the hot steel will be dropped automatically in there.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest2A0C395E: Tossing certain items into a filled mana pool can imbue them with mana, or convert them to other items.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest2F594776: Milk is a crucial ingredient in many food items.
It can now be obtained using the smeltery, but its up to you to figure out how.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest33B744F6: If you are confused how to set up multiblock structures, look no further than the schematic table!
Hold the blueprints in your mainhand to place, then move it to your offhand for a visual aid.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest33C923AD: The Crucible requires quite a bit of precision.
It is highly recommended that you read the entry on it in the Ars Ecclesia to have enough information to get the crafting method correct.
It might be tough to get the crafting process right straight away. So make sure you always make some extra ingredients as a backup.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest34E24CF9: You can convert Empty Fuses into Soul Fuses using the soul wand.
Simply drop the Empty Fuses on the ground and hit them with the soul wand.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest365B8713: Check JEI for information on how to obtain this.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest383ABAC0: The putty knife can remove wallpaper from the walls without losing durability.
Now it is up to you to invent a contraption to automate this task.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest3A9977E3: The Alloy Klin can't be automated but there is another way to make infinite lava using Buckets filled with Cobblestone. This is entirely optional but something to keep in mind for when you find yourself running out of fuel all the time.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest3EEB10E1: Did you know you can break ceiling lamps by throwing bricks at them? You will need some of these to move forwards.
You may have also noticed invisible blocks interfering with crops, liquids, or create contraptions. If this happens, breaking the light above can fix it.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest451A7918: The Igneous Extruder can be used to generate a lot of different items. The machine must always be next to lava, other adjacent blocks will decide the output.
Recipes can be found in JEI.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest4668CC2A: Rich soil can be created by placing organic compost and letting it decompose.
This process can be sped up by mushrooms or water.
Tip: Rich soil will massively boost the growth speed of any crops planted on it!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest487416EC: Certain aquatic items can only be obtained by using this special bait.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest49C7CFA2: A cloche will allow the automatic cultivation of whatever crop you plant inside it.
It will need the correct soil type and sufficient power, but can be much more convenient than farming by hand!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest4CB1AA5F: Dirt can be created by fermenting carpet with bonemeal and sugar in a keg.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest4D229B72: Some crops will need to be found through exploration...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest54A8A171: With the Time in a Bottle, you can accelerate single blocks using the amount of time you have had the Bottle in your inventory.
Just be careful not to click on a basin with it...
The Best Item in the Pack
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest54E961EC: It is time to get some power generation going!
You can connect your machines using the wires from Immersive Engineering, but they can be a bit unsafe to be around. You might prefer to use the Fluxducts from Thermal Expansion.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest552D47F0: The soul energy this wand produces can convert Bricks into Netherbricks.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest55B7C4D0: Using bamboo, you can now make infinite wood without having to rely on your local furniture.
A block of bamboo can also be turned into charcoal. This should help with feeding the fuel-hungry steam engine.
Remember that snad can be used to boost growth.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest5D6B1E47: Computers can most often be found in those infested areas you have likely been avoiding...
But if you want diamonds, what choice do you have?
Tip: You may have noticed that Sculk Carapace is extraordinarily hard, resisting even the sturdiest of pickaxes. Perhaps an explosion could blast through it?
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest5D74C2FD: The Blast furnace can produce Hot Steel. In order to cool the ingots down, you can right-click the Hot Steel on a cauldron filled with water.
Do note that there is a 10%% chance for the steel to crack. Cracked Steel can be reheated in the blast furnace to turn it into new Hot Steel.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest61201A2E: When placed in a large enough water source, the aquatic entangler will automatically begin catching those strange fish.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest65D2BC79: The Crystalliser can grow an array of important crystals.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest68DFDA75: Cod can be summoned with a ritual.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest68E4B9DB: Blocks of Bamboo can be turned into Charcoal using the coke oven.
This also makes Coal Coke fully renewable.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest69C338CC: Wallpaper can be dissolved in Redstone Acid to yield the poisonous lead dust within.
It may be wise to automate the collection of wallpaper.
Luckily, you may have noticed that the walls magically regrow their wallpaper back over time.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest6B20A48A: With the crafty crate, you can now set up a simple auto-crafting system!
You cannot manually add or remove items, but it will work for now.
Configuring the crate with crafting patterns can make crafting certain shaped recipes easier.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest6C092286: The Forged Eye can be created after you unlock the Keg and the blast furnace.
But, it may be easier to wait until later since it requires a lot of resources to forge.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest6FDBD3A1: All kinds of different seeds and vegetables can be obtained by brushing Dirt, Mud, and carpet dust on a Cutting Board.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest70593BCE: The Industrial Mixer can be used to produce Redstone Acid. This acid is essential in the chemical reaction to make Rose Quartz.
Make sure to filter the output of the machine since the input water can be extracted from the output if no Redstone Acid is being made.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest7122161E: Summoning mobs with magic is essential since they will not spawn naturally.
JEI is not super clear about this, but luckily there is this handy guidebook to point you in the right direction.
Simply put the ingedients down as discribed and ignite the charcoal on the brazier in order to start the summoning process.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest72C1746E: With bamboo, you can now craft a fishing rod.
There are a few new types of fish to be found in this way.
Some items can only be caught if the water source is sufficiently large enough, and there are no lights on directly above.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest78D4CF60: With your newly generated mana you can now use a Runic Altar. Simply redirect the stored mana in the manapool towards the Runic Altar using a Mana Spreader.
In the Lexa Botania you can read more on how to make runes with the Runic Altar.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.quest78F13758: The Heavy Engineering Frame marks the start of the construction of the heavier machines. They will form the foundation for the factory that is being constructed.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.questD7F62210: The Brazier Circle can do all kinds of rituals.
One of the most noteworthy is the abillity to summon mobs.
Consult the "Ars Eccelecia" and "Summoning 101" for more information.
My Friend Thinks he is a Wizard
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.questE7531501: Soulshards can be obtained by performing a soul crystallization ritual near undead mobs. Skulked Husks are probably your best option for this.
Bonemeal will be needed for the ritual. It can be obtained by crushing bones dropped by husks, or by using the composter.
You can consult the Ars Ecclesia for more detailed information.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.questEC3D0227: Diamond brushes last much longer than string ones, can be used faster, and yield items more often!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_3.title: Chapter 3
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest12CC2DCC: Fiberboard can be made using the Refinery and the Fermenter. It is the base component for brass casings.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest18F119F4: With the sequential fabricator, you can much more easily auto-craft items.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest1BB79E9A: With Heavy Engineering Blocks you can now summon blazes using the brazier.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest222698B6: The guidebook on building the Reality Frame gives you a handy visualiser to aid in constructing the multiblock.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest246A2048: The Machine Frame can be made by making the bottom and the top half and attaching the segments together.
This process can be done manually by hand, or it can be automated.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest25E2BB23: Using the Arc Furnace you can make steel without the risk of cracking it.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest2DB91AF3: A small amount of terrasteel is needed to make the Reality Frame, so it is time to catch up on Botania.
Make sure to have multiple mana pools ready, as otherwise the items will despawn before the terrasteel conversion process is complete.

Tip: Mana Tablets can serve as a very convenient method of transferring mana between pools, and black lotus will give your pools a burst of mana when tossed in, to help with the massive mana cost of terrasteel.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest37FD897C: The Reality Charge acts as the power source of the Reality Frame.
After the Frame is done generating, the Reality Charge will need to be empowered again, so it is a very good idea to set up a Confusing Powder farm.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest491DE9FB: With confusing powder and a Crucible you can convert lead into gold.
The contraption needed to automate the Crucible might take some tinkering, but it is possible.
No need for a Philosopher's Stone
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest4969351B: Using Brass Casings you can now make all the brass components for create and start your own liminal transport network.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest53563EF6: By extruding sculk blocks, you can collect renewable copper!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest576730F1: The Wall Piercer can be used to destroy the near-indestructible walls of the backrooms.
Simply place a Wall Piercer on either side of a wall and right-click on one of them to remove the block that is between them.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest5CE78F3B: Oil can be tapped out of Crude Oil Soaked Carpet endlessly by right-clicking it with a sponge.
Uppon right-clicking Crude Oil will erupt from the carpet, ready to be picked up.
It is recommended that you automate this process.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest5E7D7324: There are meteors of Sky Stone scattered throughout the backrooms. At the core of them, you should be able to find a mysterious cube containing all four presses.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest5FD115F7: The Atomic Reconstructor can reform materials on the atomic level to form special crystals.
Void Crystals will be needed first. They can be made from Black Quartz.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest641ACE31: You can turn Light Oil into Refined Fuel.
Blazes will get superheated when you give them a straw and pump Refined Fuel into them. This will make your steam engine burn a whole lot brighter.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest6425A4B3: Using the Reality Frame, you can generate small chunks of terrain from other dimensions, determined by the seed that is written on the chip.
This is essential for your escape since this is the only way to obtain certain materials.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest64C1F773: &oAlchemy: the science of understanding, deconstructing, and reconstructing matter. However, it is not an all-powerful art.
&oIt is impossible to create something out of nothing. If one wishes to obtain something, something of equal value must be given.
&oThis is the law of equivalent exchange; the basis of all alchemy. In accordance to this law, there is a taboo among alchemists. Human transmutation is strictly forbidden.
&oFor what could equal the value of a human soul?
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest6762380E: The Fractionating Still can turn Crude Oil into Bitumen leading to the creation of Tar when using this machine in combination with the Pyroliser.
Additionally, the Fractionating Still can also be used to make Refined Fuel. This can be turned into a good amount of power or heat for the Steam Engine.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest6A05A3E4: With the Dimensional Stabiliser you can load chunks remotely.
This is essential for setting up a mining outpost.
You will need local power generation. The Thermoelectric Generator can be a good solution to this problem.
Loading what you are not observing
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest6DB9FC4B: The Industrial Fermenter can produce the Ethanol that will be needed to make Phenolic Resin in the Refinery.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest754899C6: The ME system can be quite rewarding to set up. Remember that systems without an ME Controller can only have up to 8 devices, so use your channels sparingly.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest796F8618: The Induction Smelter can be used to create a lot of advanced items.
It is especially useful for the automatic creation of Fluorecent Lights and Vacuum Tubes.
These two items are both needed for Electronic Components and
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest7B6D55B2: By extruding porous stone, you can collect renewable zinc!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest7BC25405: The Empowerer needs to be surrounded by four Display Stands in all cardinal directions. When powered by the right amount of energy, they can empower all kinds of crystals that you will need for the late-game.
Make sure there is a gap of 2 blocks between the stands and the empowerer.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest7C4DB3B5: The ominous energy that soul flames produce seems to have strange effects on certain items. This can be automated using a fan.
With this, quartz is finally renewable!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest7DB91F36: The Pyrolizer can be used to turn Bitumen into Tar.
Tar will be needed to empower the Void Crystals.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest7F91B09D: The Refinery can produce Phenolic Resin using the Ethanol from the Industrial Fermenter.
A silver plate is needed to catalyse the reaction. The plate will not be consumed.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest8235994F: With mechanical crafters, you can assemble ingredients to automatically craft items!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest913EDBE5: Transfer energy with the power of invisible lasers!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.quest9957D0DF: When applied to items, this strange ivy will allow them to stick with you, even through death...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.questFFB86B74: By extruding red carpet, you can collect renewable iron!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_4.title: Chapter 4
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest16BED30D: Many of the reality chips require resources only obtained from each other.
Make sure to try them all!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest1D6D27D8: Alfglass can be converted to Bifrost blocks with a wand of the bifrost.
Its magical essance can then be harnessed by melting it down.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest202EF641: The tempad allows you to freely teleport anywhere you have been before every three minutes.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest20D04D00: By constructing a proper portal, you can begin to trade items with otherworldly elves.
Check the Lexica Botania if you need help with this.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest245653B3: But not bread. They hate bread.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest26F8FABD: When a Shadowgem Block is right-clicked with Chromatic Compound, it will turn into Shadow Steel.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest285A77D1: You can summon Dragon's Breath using the summoning brazier. You need to be quick to pick it up, so have your bottles ready.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest2A8B73B5: Osmium can be found in one of the Reality Chips.
It is up to you to figure out which one...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest2EB9B210: Intentionally corrupting a data chip may have adverse effects when attempting to use it on the reality frame...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest34D7245B: Placing a bucket of magma will summon a small magma cube.
If the magma cube is eaten by a frog it will drop a froglight.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest39C823B4: The core of the most advanced machines.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest3BC41EDA: Fluxducts can transfer energy much more efficiently than wires, as well as safely!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest3BDAAFC3: Frogs need to be summoned into existence in order to start making froglights.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest441BC926: Some of the Reality Chips generate ores that are quite valuable.
Setting up some automated mining operation might be a good idea.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest46BDA25C: Forming a singularity takes a LOT of matter. This can be either items or liquid.
A data chip is needed to store the matter during the compacting process, but don't worry, it is not consumed.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest542DAE1D: A large health sacrifice must be made to create this eye.
Either from yourself or a nearby mob...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest55761765: Wither skeletons can be summoned in. They will always drop their skull exactly like other summoned mobs.
The coal needed for the summoning ritual can be obtained with the Reality Frame.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest5E7F01F0: With the Enchanter, you can carefully enscribe books with any enchantment you want!

It takes much more experience, but may be preferred over the randomness of the normal enchanting table. Plus, it can even be used to easily imbue your tools with treasure enchantments the normal enchanting table cannot yield.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest628045C2: The ME crafting terminal can craft items so fast, it is actually instant!
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest6474DAB2: The reality Frame can be used to warp in a black hole.
The process is the same as normal. However, the modified data chip should be used instead of a normal one to start the warping.
When the back hole has formed you can right-click it with a singularity.
The singularity will be consumed and the back hole will spit out pieces of antimatter in return.
The Reality Frame information book can be consulted for more information.
Inside these Equations there are Monsters
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest67B868A1: With the soul enchanter, you can add or boost enchantments one level at a time.
Do so wisely, as this process taints the tool with a lingering magic, and each can only be boosted 5 times.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest6DA0C1A9: One of the Reality Chips will generate End Stone, which can be crushed to yeild Ender Dust.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest70BC2054: Making the rest of the data chips will require many charged certus quartz crystals.
While this can be done with the charger, the tesla charger can do so automatically and far more efficiently.
It may also be very helpful to have a growth accelerator, which massively boosts crystal growth on any adjacent budding certus quartz blocks.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest71B9B26E: Bees will be needed to obtain one of the eyes.
If you need more flowers, perhaps a certain mob will need to be summoned.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest7321D8BB: A few Reality Chips have Netherrack in them. This can be used to make Blaze Cakes.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest7C74C4D1: The Cryptic Eye can be created by right-clicking a lot of enchanted books on a block of hyper experience.
The fact that it slowly gains more sentience over time does not really seem to bother you...
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest7F978F43: Grass can finally be obtained from one of the reality frame chips!
There are a few new seeds that can be obtained from it.
ftbquests.chapter.sector_5.quest8AA2EDF4: To summon more complicated mobs you will need to get Moderate Soul Gems.
A health sacrifice must be made to complete the ritual. Health from any mob can be used. If no other mob is nearby then the health will be taken from the nearest player instead.
